content.purchase_options_plan_copy: Plans come from the product's selling plans. In each plan's description, the first paragraph is the summary, the second (one line per step) is the delivery timeline, and the third is the perks line. Separate paragraphs with a blank line. Hidden when the product has no selling plans.

info.recommended_label: Leave blank to hide the tag
info.savings_label: Use [amount] for the saving. Shown only when the plan has a discount.
info.button_price_label: Added after the add to cart text. Use [price] for the selected price. Leave blank to hide.
